notes.title: 4D Golf arrives March 22!
notes.content:
I’m excited to announce that 4D Golf has a release date - March 22nd 2024!   

[previewyoutube=y53UNskR-zU;full][/previewyoutube]
The game has received major graphical and gameplay overhauls including:
[list][*]Over 120 levels
[*]A level editor
[*]Ball and putter customization
[*]Local multiplayer
[*]New track types
[*]New challenges
[*]Major surprises 
[/list]
Thank you for all the support and feedback over the years, it’s been a challenging but rewarding process to bring 4D Golf into existence. I hope this game provides a deeper hands-on understanding of 4D space. 

Wishlist it on Steam and enjoy the new gameplay trailer! ⛳🏌️
